remarks_1999: Double entries Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive (American Art Research Council Questionnaires) indicates, "Identified by O'Keeffe as #7 in 1936 exhibition at Amer. Place." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1935. Dated 1934 on basis of inclusion in 1935 New York (An American Place) exhibition and Stieglitz—O'Keeffe correspondence; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 61. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Purple Hills Ghost Ranch – 2/Purple Hills No II

description: Horizontal landscape of dark reddish crimson clay hills that flow down into softly rounded smaller hills below.  The smaller hills are a lighter pink tinged with grey at the tops.
